Cloudflare Details GLM-5.3 Workers AI KV Cache Exposure

2026-10-27 · AI-assisted, source-attributed report

According to Cloudflare, a configuration mismatch in the GLM 5.3 model on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that caused the exposure of KV cache pages across different requests. Cloudflare reported on its official blog how it addressed and remediated the issue following the incident. The publisher outlined the technical factors involved in the cross-request exposure, detailing the specific interaction between the model configuration and the SGLang bug. Readers should consult the official Cloudflare blog post for the complete account and technical breakdown of the remediation steps taken by the team.
